AI Input

Single-line input fields with AI icons, suggestion dropdowns, and action buttons for quick AI interactions.

Basic AI Input

Input with an AI sparkle icon prefix.

HTML
<div class="zak-ai-input-wrap">
    <svg class="zak-ai-input-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
        <path d="M12 2l2.4 7.2L22 12l-7.6 2.8L12 22l-2.4-7.2L2 12l7.6-2.8z"/>
    </svg>
    <input type="text" class="zak-ai-input" placeholder="Ask AI anything...">
</div>

Input with Send Button

Input with a gradient send button for submitting queries.

HTML
<div class="zak-ai-input-wrap">
    <svg class="zak-ai-input-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">...</svg>
    <input type="text" class="zak-ai-input" placeholder="Ask AI anything..." style="padding-right:2.75rem">
    <button class="zak-ai-input-send" aria-label="Send">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M22 2L11 13M22 2l-7 20-4-9-9-4z"/></svg>
    </button>
</div>

With Suggestions Dropdown

Input that shows clickable suggestions on focus.

Write a blog post about...
Summarize this article...
Explain how to...
Generate code for...
HTML
<div class="zak-ai-input-wrap" style="flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch">
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem">
        <svg class="zak-ai-input-icon">...</svg>
        <input type="text" class="zak-ai-input" id="ai-input-suggest"
               placeholder="Start typing..." autocomplete="off">
        <button class="zak-ai-input-send" aria-label="Send">...</button>
    </div>
    <div class="zak-ai-suggestions" id="ai-suggestions-dropdown">
        <div class="zak-ai-suggestion-item">Write a blog post about...</div>
        <div class="zak-ai-suggestion-item">Summarize this article...</div>
        <div class="zak-ai-suggestion-item">Explain how to...</div>
    </div>
</div>

CSS Classes

HTML
.zak-ai-input-wrap         /* Flex container for input + addons */
.zak-ai-input              /* Base input with left padding for icon */
.zak-ai-input-icon         /* Sparkle icon, absolutely positioned left */
.zak-ai-input-send         /* Gradient send button, absolutely positioned right */
.zak-ai-input-model        /* Model selector dropdown */
.zak-ai-suggestions        /* Suggestions dropdown container */
.zak-ai-suggestion-item    /* Individual suggestion row */
.zak-ai-char-count         /* Character count text */
.zak-ai-input-with-actions /* Container for input + standalone button */
.zak-ai-input-ask-btn      /* Standalone "Ask AI" gradient button */

JavaScript

Show/hide suggestions dropdown and update character count.

HTML
// Suggestions dropdown
const input = document.getElementById('ai-input-suggest');
const dropdown = document.getElementById('ai-suggestions-dropdown');
if (input && dropdown) {
    input.addEventListener('focus', () => dropdown.classList.add('show'));
    input.addEventListener('blur', () => setTimeout(() => dropdown.classList.remove('show'), 200));
    dropdown.querySelectorAll('.zak-ai-suggestion-item').forEach(item => {
        item.addEventListener('click', () => {
            input.value = item.textContent.trim();
            dropdown.classList.remove('show');
            input.focus();
        });
    });
}

// Character count
const countInput = document.getElementById('ai-input-count');
const charDisplay = document.getElementById('ai-char-display');
if (countInput && charDisplay) {
    countInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
        charDisplay.textContent = countInput.value.length;
    });
}
